detail: JCHAC India Holdco Ltd submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE in relation to Bosch Home Comfort India Limited. The filing represents a material share acquisition event requiring regulatory transparency and adherence to SEBI's acquisition framework.
